function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

message.content:
I’m afraid I don’t have real‑time access to event listings, so I can’t pull up the exact “next” festival happening in the United States right now. However, I can help you locate that information and give you an idea of some popular festivals that typically occur soon.

---

### How to Find Upcoming Festivals

| Resource | What It Offers | How to Use |
|----------|----------------|------------|
| **Eventbrite** | Search by city, state, or zip code; filter by date | Go to Eventbrite.com → type your location → set the date range to “This week” or “Next month.” |
| **Songkick** | Music concerts & festivals; shows by artist | Visit Songkick.com → sign up → add your favorite artists or just browse the calendar. |
| **Festicket** | Festival tickets & travel packages | Check Festicket.com → choose “United States” → see upcoming festivals. |
| **Local tourism sites** | City or state tourism boards often list major events | Search “[City] tourism” → look under “Events” or “Calendar.” |
| **Google Calendar / Google Search** | Quick “upcoming festivals near me” | Type “upcoming festivals in [your city/state]” into Google. |

---

### Popular U.S. Festivals That Usually Happen Soon

| Festival | Typical Time of Year | Location | Notes |
|----------|----------------------|----------|-------|
| **Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival** | Mid-April | Indio, California | Two weekends; huge lineup. |
| **Lollapalooza** | Late July | Chicago, Illinois | One weekend; indie rock & pop. |
| **New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival** | Mid-June | New Orleans, Louisiana | Two weeks; jazz, blues, world music. |
| **Burning Man** | Early August | Black Rock Desert, Nevada | Weeklong art & community event. |
| **South by Southwest (SXSW)** | Mid-March | Austin, Texas | Film, music, interactive media. |
| **Bonnaroo Music & Arts Festival** | Mid-July | Manchester, Tennessee | Three days; eclectic lineup. |
| **Electric Daisy Carnival (EDC)** | Late May | Las Vegas, Nevada | EDM-focused; massive crowds. |

*(These dates are approximate and can vary year to year.)*

---

### Next Steps

1. **Decide on the type of festival** you’re interested in (music, food, arts, etc.).
2. **Choose a location** or let the search be nationwide.
3. **Use one of the resources above** to find the most current schedule.

If you tell me more about the kind of festival you’re looking for—genre, location preference, budget—I can narrow down suggestions or guide you through setting up alerts for when tickets become available.
